title: cheirolophus benoistii
intro: Cheirolophus benoistii, commonly known as the Seychelles copperleaf, is a species of flowering plant in the daisy family Asteraceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce the risk of chronic diseases such as heart disease and cancer. The therapeutic actions of Cheirolophus benoistii include its ability to protect against cell damage, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial and antifungal activities. The bioactive constituents of Cheirolophus benoistii include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
